saints.name: St. Junípero Serra
saints.title: Priest and Missionary
saints.shortBlurb: The Franciscan friar who founded the first missions of California and is called its apostle…
biography: Born on the island of Majorca in 1713, Miguel José Serra took the name Junípero when he entered the Order of Friars Minor, and won distinction as a professor of philosophy before leaving the university for the missions of the New World in 1749. After years of labor in Mexico, he was sent north into Alta California, where in 1769 he founded the first mission, San Diego de Alcalá.

Though often in poor health and hindered by a lame leg, he traveled thousands of miles on foot and established a chain of missions along the California coast, baptizing and instructing the native peoples. He died at Mission San Carlos Borromeo in Carmel in 1784, having founded nine missions in fifteen years.
saints.knownFor: Founding the California missions and evangelizing its native peoples.
